subject: Request for latest penetration test report and secure delivery options
messages:
From: Tim Keller <tim.keller@auroraretail.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: Aurora Retail Security <security@auroraretail.com>
Date: Thu, 09 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request for latest penetration test report and secure delivery options

Hi Jonas,

We're updating our supply-chain security binder for Aurora Retail and need the most recent penetration test report that covers Redwood's hosted API (public/hosted runtime). Procurement and our security team asked for:

- Latest full PT report (redacted if necessary)
- The scope (components tested: API runtime, control plane, auth, third-party dependencies)
- Current remediation status for any open high/critical findings

Also: what secure transfer options do you support? We prefer an SFTP drop or an expiring presigned S3 link with IP restriction. If you have a secure viewer portal where we can view redacted reports without download that would work too.

Please let me know what you can share without an NDA, and what requires an NDA or SOC-2 access. We have a procurement deadline next week, so a 48-72 hour turnaround would be ideal.

Thanks,
Tim Keller
Security Program Manager
Aurora Retail
---
Aurora Retail Security <security@auroraretail.com>
From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Tim Keller <tim.keller@auroraretail.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 09 Apr 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request for latest penetration test report and secure delivery options

Hi Tim — thanks for the clear ask and the timeline. I'm looping in Laura from our Security team and Sergio (your account exec) so we can get you the right level of detail quickly.

Short answers up front:
- We can provide a redacted PT summary (public findings and remediation status) within 48 hours without an NDA.
- The full report (including customer-specific test cases and raw evidence) requires an NDA and an access control process; delivery can be via an S3 presigned URL with IP restriction + password, ShareFile, or a one-time secure viewer session.

Couple quick clarifying Qs that will help us scope the deliverable:
1) Do you need the granular remediation evidence (logs/patch diffs) or is a redacted report + remediation plan sufficient for procurement?
2) If you prefer presigned S3, can you provide the IP range(s) you'll use for the download? That lets us issue a URL scoped to your network.

Laura — can you confirm current remediation status (high/critical) and whether we can share the redacted PDF and a short remediation summary now?

Tim — once we confirm the level of access you need, Sergio will share the access method and the ticket for audit purposes.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
Phone: (510) 555-0142

Date: Fri, 10 Apr 2026 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request for latest penetration test report and secure delivery options

Hi Tim — Laura from Redwood Security here. Thanks for the request. Below is what we can share today and the secure options for delivery.

What we can send now (no NDA required):
- Redacted executive PT summary (attached: pt_summary_2026-03.txt) that includes scope, top findings (summary level), and remediation status by category.
- Scope confirmed: hosted inference runtime, control plane (management consoles), authentication layers, and direct third-party dependencies used in runtime (container base images, common libraries). Note: testing excludes customer-owned integrations and customer-provided prompt data.

What requires an NDA and access controls:
- Full PT report with test traces, attack payloads, and customer-specific findings.
- Raw evidence (logs, POC code).

Secure delivery options we support:
1) Presigned S3 URL with: 24-hour expiry, IP restriction to your download IPs, and password-protected zip. (preferred for automated procurement workflows)
2) Citrix ShareFile or similar enterprise dropbox with restricted viewer/download.
3) One-time secure viewer session (read-only) hosted by Redwood security.

Current remediation status (summary):
- All low/medium findings from the March engagement are closed.
- One high-severity finding related to token validation during a simulated replay attack is open; mitigation is in progress and a patch has been scheduled for 2026-04-15 (ETA). We will provide a short technical write-up of the mitigation steps in the full report under NDA.

Attachments included in this message: pt_summary_2026-03.txt (contains the redacted executive summary). Full report filename: redwood_pt_report_2026-03.pdf (available on request under NDA).

Ticket reference for this request: SVC-4821 (https://support.redwood.example.com/tickets/SVC-4821)

If you can confirm: 1) whether a redacted summary is sufficient for procurement, and 2) the IP range for presigned URL or if you prefer an NDA route, we'll proceed immediately.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Security Lead, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai

Laura — thanks, that helps. A redacted executive summary will get procurement moving. We also need a high-level write-up of the open high-severity finding and the remediation ETA for our risk committee (the patch ETA of 2026-04-15 is fine; can you include the public remediation steps in the summary?).

For the full report under NDA we prefer an S3 presigned URL with IP restriction. Our download IP range is 52.14.23.0/24. I'll get the legal team to send a standard mutual NDA today; once that's in place we can coordinate the presigned link and a brief technical call.

One more ask for audit: can you provide your SOP for evidence transfer and retention (how long the presigned URL remains available, whether copies are retained by Redwood after sharing)? That will go into our audit binder.

I'll confirm once legal sends the NDA. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Tim
